name: Yu Sishen Duguo de Qi Ri ~Last Days~
original_name: 與死神渡過的七日 ～Last days～
source:
"You will die after 7 days"
A teen called herself death appeared in the afternoon on Christmas day.

"I will be with you this week..... if you don't want to die, find someone who will give up everything for you."
A unilateral declaration with strange signs makes people believe in this.

The daily life becomes unpredictable, and yet run into the belle of the class - Shaw Chin, who just ended a relationship. Will she become somebody who's going to love me for me?

Subtle relationship with Shaw Chin.
Heavy on death's mind.

When the fireworks light up the new year eve's sky, you have to make your choice.....
